sloka: एकस्य रामस्य वने निवास ।स्त्वया वृतह् केकयराजपुत्रि ।विभूषितेयम् प्रतिकर्मनित्या ।वसत्वरण्ये सह राघवेण ॥२-३७-३५॥
transliteration: ekasya rāmasya vane nivāsa ।stvayā vṛtah kekayarājaputri ।vibhūṣiteyam pratikarmanityā ।vasatvaraṇye saha rāghaveṇa ॥2-37-35॥

translations.english: O Kaikeyi, you asked that Rama only should dwell in the forest (wearing bark robes). Therefore let Sita, adorn her body daily, while she lives in the forest with Rama.
